about.title: About Article Illustrator
about.subtitle: Bringing your words to life with AI-powered visuals.
about.intro: Article Illustrator is a tool designed to help writers, bloggers, and content creators quickly generate high-quality illustrations for their articles. By combining advanced text and image AI models, we make it effortless to visualize your ideas.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.step1: Paste your article into the editor.
how_it_works.step2: The AI parses your text into logical paragraphs.
how_it_works.step3: Select a style and generate a tailored image prompt.
how_it_works.step4: Create unique illustrations powered by Pollinations AI.

privacy_credits.title: Privacy & Credits
privacy_credits.privacy: We value your privacy. Your article text and generated images are processed in real-time and never stored on our servers. The app uses your own Pollinations Pollen to ensure you have full control over your usage.
privacy_credits.credits: This project is powered by Pollinations.ai, providing the underlying AI models for both text generation and image synthesis.
